summary: Capiz 1st District representative with 203 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant items are a tax deduction for parents of special children and fuel excise suspension, both taxation. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Only 3 rubric bills surfaced from 203, so evidence may be incomplete.
